events.title: Lonefarm is back: a new demo for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hi everyone! It's been a long time since I last shared an update about Lonefarm. Before getting into what's new, I wanted to say I'm sorry for being away and for letting so much time go by without any news. A few years ago, I had to put the project on hold because of personal and health issues that needed my full attention. It wasn't an easy decision. events.title: Devblog 1 is here!
events.summary: VOLKSWAGEN BUS PICKUP 1966 https://i.imgur.com/dAygPfy.jpeg Also known as Transporter, Kombi or Microbus it was one of the precursors of cargo vehicles. I decided to create a vehicle for Lonefarm inspired by this beautiful bus because I love the shape and versatility. It was also iconic in the 1960s.
